name: protection from evil and good
lore:
# Abjuration: Protection from Evil and Good

To master this foundational abjuration is to understand the geometry of the soul. As you draw upon the Weave, the magic feels like pulling silken threads into a rigid, crystalline lattice—a sensation of profound, bracing coolness that settles the pulse and clears the mind of doubt.

Once manifested, the spell surrounds the subject in a faint, iridescent nimbus, shimmering like oil upon still water. To the profane—be they fiends, fey, or the restless dead—this aura is more than a light; it is a physical rejection of their discordant essence, an invisible barrier of absolute order.

Chronicles attribute its discovery to the blind hermit-monk, **Thalric of the White Peak**. Legend holds that while besieged by a cacophony of howling shadows, Thalric did not strike out in fear. Instead, he hummed a single, perfect note of cosmic harmony. The shadows shattered against his calm, and the first "Circle of Warding" was etched into history. 

Carry this light into the dark, traveler; it is the thin, shimmering boundary between your spirit and the void.
